    action(['LEFT'])
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'b':
            cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            player_col = min(cols)
    print(f"After LEFT {i+1}: player_col={player_col}, level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed', False)}")
